MAILGUN_API_KEY.description: Mailgun's own SDK reads this name and says not to publish the private key in frontend code. No pattern is declared: the key- prefix is widely repeated but the current reference shows only a placeholder. Rotate quarterly by creating a key and revoking the old.

MAILGUN_DOMAIN.description: The key alone will not send: every call names a domain. Public, being the domain your mail comes from. A sending key scoped to one domain is narrower than the account key above. The name is convention.
